race.description: Goulburn Express Freight Country Mdn Plate
race.comment: DAYLITE (7) finds a very ordinary Maiden and can get the better of these at his third race start. Chipped away last start when fourth over 1200m at this track. Can overcome the wide gate and not be taken lightly. HAMPTON STYLE (4) Snitzel mare who returns after four months in the paddock. Ran on late in her two career starts and expected to have strengthened over the break. Top three contender. HARLEM TICKLE (5) deep into the preparation and kept fresh for this. Struggled over the 1600m when eighth at this track on July 3. Assess on the good fourth here two back over the 1300m. Each way. RAWANO (2) resumes. Drifted back early and failed to get into the contest with a poor tenth over 1425m at Moruya on June 19. Has to be respected. Ran some okay races last prep and place best. FOLSOMPRISONHOOVES (10) three-year-old filly by Doubtland filly out of Equiseta on debut for the Tom Wilson yard. Average trial and has slim place claims.
